name: Lysozyme C
blurb: Antibacterial enzyme in tears and saliva that cuts bacterial cell walls.

misfolded.name: Lysozyme amyloid
misfolded.description: Destabilising mutations let lysozyme partly unfold and form amyloid in the kidney, liver and gut.

function: Lysozymes have primarily a bacteriolytic function; those in tissues and body fluids are associated with the monocyte-macrophage system and enhance the activity of immunoagents
